name: Wadayama (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Wadayama town emblem in white: a ring open at the top and bottom enclosing a stylised letter A.
history: Flag of the former town of Wadayama in Hyōgo Prefecture, dissolved on 2005-04-01. The municipal emblem was adopted on 15 March 1962.

features.role: Wadayama town emblem — a ring open at the top and bottom enclosing a stylised letter A
